items.text: Looker The agentic BI platform built on a trusted semantic layer Move from static dashboards to governed, AI-driven action. Powered by Gemini, Looker pairs an industry-leading universal semantic layer with conversational analytics, MCP integration, and extensible APIs—so every user and AI agent works from a single source of truth. Blend ad hoc CSVs and local files alongside governed LookML models in seconds, and explore the latest Google Data Cloud innovations to move from question to decision in your flow of work. How It Works Looker is the experience layer for the Agentic Data Cloud.

Define business logic once in LookML to give Conversational Analytics, Dashboard Agents, and MCP-connected tools the governed context they need to turn raw data into trusted action.
